subject: Private offer coordination: reseller approval & billing workflow
messages:
From: John Park <partners@acme-resell.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@summitcloud.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. SummitCloud (our buyer) asked for a channel private offer (CPPO) so they can commit to a 12-month reserved package. We need your help with two items to get the AWS CPPO created and approved on our side:

1) A clean copy of your current CPPO terms (including billing contact and tax/legal name) we can upload to AWS.
2) A short invoice-routing diagram and PO instructions so SummitCloud knows how to route the committed spend.

Timeline: they want the PO signed and the CPPO in AWS by the first week of December. Can your team make the legal/ops artifacts available by Friday 11/27?

I can also introduce you to our AWS marketplace lifecycle contact if helpful.

Appreciate it —
John
Partnerships, Acme Resell Co.
phone: +1 415-555-0192
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Park <partners@acme-resell.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

Thanks John — happy to move quickly. Attaching: redwood_cppo_terms_v3.docx and a simple invoice-routing map.

Quick clarifications so we align:
- Legal name for invoicing: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: XX-XXXXXXX) — Rafael, please confirm if we should include additional tax docs.
- Billing contact for Marketplace settlements: finance@redwoodinference.com (Marissa will own the first settlement).
- AWS seller account ID: 9876543210 — John, confirm your reseller registration maps to Marketplace partner ID 520-ACME.

Next steps:
1) Rafael to confirm if any contract redlines are expected.
2) Marissa to share preferred PO routing and bill-to text.
3) John to share the Marketplace partner contact so we can request CPPO creation with AWS.

I will also schedule a short ops call for Friday (30 mins) to finalize.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Channel Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

On internal review — two small asks from legal/finance:
1) Add standard data residency clause referencing EU region exclusions (this is template language; harmless for a US-bound deal).
2) Confirm whether SummitCloud needs invoicing to a different legal entity (they sometimes route via SummitCloud Holdings). 

Marissa: can you draft the short bill-to text and confirm the finance contact? Once I see that, legal will sign off on the CPPO terms and we can send to DocuSign.

Rafael
Head of Legal Ops (covering commercial contracts)
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

Quick billing note:
- Bill-to: SummitCloud Technologies, Inc.
- PO instructions: send PO to procurement@redwoodinference.com and include the HubSpot deal id (12345678) on the PO line; remit to Redwood Inference, Inc., 1201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.
- Finance contact for AWS settlement: accounting@redwoodinference.com

Jonas: can we confirm the Marketplace entitlements mapping (SKUs) — SummitCloud expects metered + reserved seats buckets. If you can pull the SKU slug and mapping, I will paste into the CPPO request.

Marissa
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: John Park <partners@acme-resell.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Ops <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>, procurement@summitcloud.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround. AWS ops asked us to submit the CPPO request together with: signed vendor terms, the bill-to text, and a DocuSign envelope so they can validate the seller account and partner mapping. I created a DocuSign packet and copied the link here: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?s=ABCDEF123456

We expect AWS to provision the CPPO within 48–72 hours after submission. If that timeline holds, SummitCloud can issue the PO on 12/3 and we can finalize onboarding the week of 12/6.

John
Acme Resell Co.
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: John Park <partners@acme-resell.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood CPPO — next steps from Acme

All set — Rafael and Marissa have signed off on the materials. Rafael: legal will execute the DocuSign envelope today. Marissa: please confirm the SKU slugs (low-latency-tier, reserved-1000-tokens/month) and I will attach to the AWS request.

Action items (owners):
- Rafael: complete DocuSign signature (today).
- Marissa: reply with SKU slugs and send final invoice-routing PNG (today).
- John: submit CPPO request to AWS once DocuSign is complete and share the AWS request ID.

If AWS takes >72 hours, we will escalate through our AWS partner manager (Jonas, looping you if needed).

Thanks team — should be smooth.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Channel Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
